items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I left him and Johnny Sincere come in the band after I left him.

ctx.x: He probably had a big sax section I would guess.
No, well he didn't have it, but it was about nine or ten pieces. Well I left him and Johnny Sincere come in the band after I left him. Oh I see. When he came back.
